Background

Kelly is a retired Navy captain and former astronaut who has represented Arizona in the Senate since 2020. He drew national attention after the Pentagon moved to demote him over a video urging service members to refuse illegal orders, and he sued Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over it.

Outlook

Kelly said he would not decide until after the midterms, and the Associated Press reports he has already talked with potential campaign staff. He polls in the mid single digits, and 22 percent of Democrats in the CNN/SSRS poll said they would be excited to back him. His military record and his clash with the administration are assets, but he lacks a large national base.
